**Title:** **Sr Team Lead\-Cloud \& Infra Operations**
======================================================

Description:
**Area(s) of responsibility**
-----------------------------


.


**Service Desk Transformation Leadership**


* Own and drive the end\-to\-end transformation roadmap from a Catch \& Dispatch model to an L1\.5 Service Desk capable of resolving incidents and requests at first point of contact.
* Define, document, and embed Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Knowledge Base articles (KBAs), and Known Error Database (KEDB) entries to enable first\-contact resolution.
* Conduct capability gap assessments across the team; design and execute structured upskilling and cross\-training programmes aligned to the L1\.5 maturity model.
* Establish measurable transformation KPIs — First Contact Resolution (FCR) rate, Average Handle Time (AHT), Ticket deflection rate, and CSAT — and report progress to stakeholders.
* Collaborate with L2/L3 resolver groups to negotiate resolution ownership boundaries, build runbooks, and progressively absorb eligible ticket categories into L1\.5\.
* Champion automation and AI\-assisted tooling (e.g., chatbots, auto\-resolution scripts, ServiceNow workflows) to reduce manual effort and scale resolution capacity.
* Implement quality assurance (QA) frameworks including call/ticket audits, coaching sessions, and continuous improvement cycles.

title: Fraud Operations - Team Manager
description:
Date live: 09/22/2026


Business Area: USCB Operations


Area of Expertise: Banking Operations


Contract: Permanent


Reference Code: JR\-0000128664


  
Step into a role of Fraud Operations \- Team Manager at Barclays, you would be responsible for the daily operations, the performance of their direct reports and the health of the process pertaining to regulatory and Association prescribed requirements in a banking environment.  

  



To thrive in this role, you will need some previous experience in:  

  



* Significant overall professional experience.
* Experience in Credit/Debit Card Operations and Fraud Operations (Chargebacks).
* Knowledge of US card regulations and banking Risk \& Control frameworks.
* Team leadership experience managing large teams.
* Previous experience of working within a fast\-paced environment.

Accountabilities:  

  



* Oversee daily staffing, workflow management, quality, and productivity standards.
* Proactively identify, manage, and escalate service delivery risks and operational issues.
* Coach, mentor, and develop team members to achieve performance objectives.
* Monitor team performance and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
* Partner with site leadership to support employee engagement and ensure operational compliance.

  

Additional preferred skills include:  

  



* Strong analytical, communication, and problem\-solving skills.
* High attention to detail with a focus on accuracy and continuous improvement.
* Ability to multitask and perform effectively under pressure.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
* Customer\-focused and results\-driven mindset.
* Strong Leadership, teamwork, and stakeholder management capabilities.

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.  

  



This role is based in Noida.


**Purpose of the role**


To manage operations within a business area and maintain processes, risk management initiatives and compliance with relevant regulators.


**Accountabilities**


* Identification of trends and opportunities to improve areas and develop new process and procedures through the monitoring and analysis of operation data and performance metrices.
* Management of operations for a business area and promote efficient processes, risk management and compliance initiatives to support the bank's operations.
* Collaboration with internal stakeholders (including business leaders, project manager and SMEs) and external stakeholders (including vendors and service providers) to support business operations and promote alignment with the bank's objectives and SLAs.
* Management of operational professionals and provide guidance, coaching and support to improve colleagues' delivery quality.
* Management and development of KPIs to measure the effectiveness of operation functions, utilising data and technology to support the identification of areas that require improvement.
* Compliance with all regulatory requirements and internal policies related to customer experience.
* Creation of a safe environment for colleagues to speak up, actively and regularly encourage and solicit feedback to ensure people agenda remains focused on the right areas.
* Management of attrition by working closely with HR in implementing retention initiatives for work force.

**Analyst Expectations**


* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in\-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub\-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Assistant Teaching Operations Manager
description:
We support peace and prosperity by building connections, understanding and trust between people in the UK and countries worldwide. For 90 years we have shaped brighter futures through education, arts, culture, language, and creativity.


Working with people in over 200 countries and territories, we are on the ground in more than 100 countries.


**We connect. We inspire.**  



**Pay Band:** 5
**Country/Location:** Noida, India
**Department:** GSS English \& Exams (English Operations)
**Contract Type:** Fixed term contract
**Contract Duration:** 1 year
**Closing Date:** 5 October 2026, 11:59 PM (IST)  

**Work Schedule:** This is a 24/7 on\-site role with rotating shifts, including night shifts. The position offers two days off per week, which may not always fall on weekends. Flexibility and adaptability to a continuous shift\-based environment are essential. There is no hybrid work arrangement for this position and it requires working onsite five days a week.  

**Role Description \& Purpose**The Assistant Teaching Operations Manager will support the effective delivery of English Online’s Teaching Operations by monitoring student booking trends and assisting in timetable optimisation. The role will contribute to planning and deploying teacher resources to meet demand while supporting cost\-effective operations across English Online’s offerings, as well as supporting data reporting and ensuring adherence to service level agreements through collaboration with the Teaching Operations Manager. Working closely with internal stakeholders, such as Partnerships, Sales and Customer Service, the Assistant Teaching Operations Manager will help plan and deliver various projects and contribute to initiatives focused on timetabling improvements and resource management efficiencies. The role will also support the recruitment, onboarding and scheduling of new teachers, ensuring adherence to British Council policies and contributing to English Online’s growth and service quality.  

**Role Accountabilities**The Assistant Teaching Operations Manager implements standard operating procedures and contributes to meeting performance targets under the guidance of the Teaching Operations Manager. The role assists in managing resourcing, timetabling, and capacity adjustments to support smooth and consistent service delivery. It ensures adherence to SLA standards with internal and external customers and suppliers by following established processes and providing timely support for issues that arise. The role also collaborates with the Teaching Operations Manager to monitor demand trends and makes preliminary adjustments to forecasts and resources as needed.
The role builds and maintains strong working relationships with internal stakeholders across English Online, supporting communication between Teaching Operations and teams such as Sales, Customer Service and Tech/Product. It provides teachers with operational updates and addresses routine queries related to timetabling and non\-academic support areas, escalating complex queries as necessary.  

The Assistant Teaching Operations Manager supports data collection and analysis efforts to inform business process improvements, generating routine reports and offering initial recommendations to the Teaching Operations Manager. The role assists in monitoring OKRs and KPIs, preparing data as needed to track performance and support reporting requirements.  

The role maintains accuracy in timetabling and booking data, monitors student booking patterns and supports forecasting adjustments in collaboration with the Teaching Operations Manager. It also assists in uploading classes and seeks approval ahead of doing so.  

The Assistant Teaching Operations Manager follows agreed corporate risk management processes and procedures when delivering services, including child protection, security policies, financial protocols and anti\-fraud measures, to protect the interests of British Council and its customers at all times.  

**Qualifications \& Experience****Essential*** Bachelors degree or equivalent.
* Experience of working in an operations/service delivery role.
* Experience of monitoring costs.
* Experience of contributing to the delivery of process improvements in a commercial context.
  

**Desirable*** Microsoft Office Specialist certification in Excel – Expert level or higher, or equivalent courses (e.g. through Coursera, Udemy, LinkedIn Learning, edX).
* Courses/certifications in data visualisation and/or AI/machine learning.
* Courses/certificates in Microsoft Power BI or Tableau.
* Experience using timetabling software or scheduling systems (e.g. in the education or travel industries).
* Experience working with a relational database.
* Experience working with hourly\-paid staff and/or non\-permanent workers.
* Experience working within the education industry.
  

**Further Information**Right to Work: Locally recruited
Applications are welcomed from candidates currently in this location with a natural right to work.  

Applications are also welcomed from candidates currently based in other British Council country offices. However, please note candidates must have a natural right to work in the country, on a permanent basis, as immigration clearance and/or on\-going visa support is not provided by the British Council for this role. Relocation support is also not provided.  

**India (OCI)**Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) card holders will need have, or be able to obtain, a valid special work permit issued from Government of India (GOI) to work in the British High Commission (BHC). BHC will not be able to sponsor work visas or obtain/ assist with the special work permit from GOI. Offers of employment made to OCI card holders will be conditional upon candidates obtaining a special work permit.
Note: For requisite special permission to take up employment in any foreign Diplomatic Missions in India, OCI Cardholder must visit https://ociservices.gov.in

We are committed to equality, diversity and inclusion and welcome applications from all sections of the community as we believe that a diverse workforce gives added depth to our work. The Disability Confident scheme helps challenge attitudes, increase understanding of disability and ensure staff are drawn from the widest possible pool of talent. description:
We support peace and prosperity by building connections, understanding and trust between people in the UK and countries worldwide. For 90 years we have shaped brighter futures through education, arts, culture, language, and creativity.


Working with people in over 200 countries and territories, we are on the ground in more than 100 countries.

**Contract Type:** Fixed Term Contract (FTC)
**Contract Duration:** 1 Year
**Closing Date:** 29 September 2026 , 11:59 PM (IST)  

**Work Schedule** : This is a 24/7 on\-site role with rotating shifts, including night shifts. The position offers two days off per week, which may not always fall on weekends. Flexibility and adaptability to a continuous shift\-based environment are essential. There is no hybrid work arrangement for this position, and it requires working onsite five days a week.  

**Training \& Assessment Requirement**  

Successful candidates will be required to complete mandatory process training and achieve the required pass mark in a competency assessment before undertaking independent production responsibilities. Support, coaching, and reassessment opportunities will be provided where applicable.  

**Role Description/Purpose**This role will deliver optimum floor support by mentoring, coaching and guiding team members, and by taking ownership for delivering an excellent customer experience. The Team Leader – Operations will be responsible for supervising, planning and managing functions relating to operations, with an important part of the role focused on supporting the operations leadership team in delivering effective and efficient services.  

**Role Accountabilities**As a process expert, you will manage complex transactions and queries and handle escalations in coordination with senior leadership and stakeholders. This includes managing the applications linked to process inboxes and dealing with enquiries, drawing on expert knowledge of the tools and technologies used within the process, and helping to improve service quality by evaluating and updating current processes and procedures. You will maintain schedule adherence, workforce management (including break management), and shift management and rotation in line with inputs from the WFM/MIS supervisor, take pre\- and post\-shift handovers with the team, act as an information source and first\-level escalation point for the floor, and create and maintain SOPs and knowledge articles for the team on a regular basis. You will also receive first\-hand training on process updates and share this with the team through a channelised Knowledge Transfer process, acting as a doer whenever required. The role sits within a 24/7 operation, requiring adherence to internal SLAs for a 24\-hour turnaround on delivery performance targets, working in shifts with two weekly offs that will not necessarily fall on a Saturday or Sunday, operating from the office, and cross\-working with colleagues located globally across British Council.  

You will be expected to read, understand and comply with information security policies, raising any incidents or non\-compliance with information security or IELTS\-related compliance policies, and ensuring compliance with organisational policies such as the code of conduct and IT policy. Using standard procedures and templates, you will produce weekly, monthly and quarterly reports for the Delivery Manager, analysing operational activity levels and performance data to support timely and effective business decisions, sharing agreed reports and dashboards on a regular basis, and practicing and ensuring compliance with BCMS policies and procedures.  

On the people management side, you will carry out performance measurements, quality monitoring and evaluation across the team to monitor service quality and improve efficiency, prepare and direct schedules, monitor attendance, and schedule breaks and shifts as necessary. You will compile and maintain lists of on\-call and key schedules and personnel, conduct regular team meetings and one\-to\-one sessions, ensure team members receive appropriate support and training, create growth plans for top performers and development plans for underperformers, handle people management queries and concerns, and coach and mentor BQs and MQs within the team in coordination with other support teams. The role also calls for the ability to pre\-empt problems and identify solutions through logical analysis, along with a drive to achieve organisational goals and support continual improvement projects.  

**Qualifications \& Experience****Essential:*** **Education:** Bachelor’s degree
* Minimum 3–5 years of work experience in Front/Back\-office processes, including having managed a team of 10–15 team members for at least 1–2 years
* English language proficiency at a minimum of IELTS band 7 or an equivalent internationally recognised qualification
* Intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Excel (BCMS will test Excel skills as part of evaluation)
* Demonstrable experience delivering training and feedback using a range of methods
* Ability to independently handle the floor, and to plan well and prioritise work
* Proactive approach with a focus on problem analysis and resolution
* Green Belt or another quality\-improvement\-related certification
* Proficient in Microsoft Office, especially Excel and Outlook
* Great interpersonal and communication skills to build effective working relationships with key stakeholders and colleagues
* Versatile, with a willingness to help one another even where this falls outside the core job description
* Motivated self\-starter, eager to learn and develop as the role expands
Willingness to contribute to BCMS objectives in service delivery

**Desirable:*** Experience independently managing shifts in previous organisations
* Experience working in a secure process/environment in previous roles

Black Belt trained/certified
